champions.name: Abaddon
champions.notes: Flexible durable hero: Aphotic Shield dispels and absorbs, Mist Coil heals, Borrowed Time makes him very hard to kill. Anti-heal and undispellable disables (AA, Doom) are the answer.

champions.name: Alchemist
champions.notes: Fastest farmer in the game; Chemical Rage regen makes him a durable mid-game fighter, and he can melt Aghanim's Scepters into allies. Needs space early; anti-heal (Ice Blast, Heartstopper) and pure damage cut his sustain.

champions.name: Ancient Apparition
champions.notes: Global Ice Blast shuts off healing and shatters low-HP targets; Cold Feet/Ice Vortex give long-range zoning and Bone Chill saps Strength. The go-to counter-pick vs regen/heal heroes; fragile vs divers.

champions.name: Anti-Mage
champions.notes: Fastest farmer and elite split-pusher who burns mana and punishes mana-reliant heroes with Mana Void; needs space and a team that can stall. Weak early and to lockdown that stops Blink (Axe Call, Duel, Rupture, Chrono, Doom).

champions.name: Arc Warden
champions.notes: Tempest Double doubles items and spells for relentless split-pushing and late-game power; mostly played mid. Hard to play; gap closers that catch the real hero punish him.

champions.name: Axe
champions.notes: Blink + Berserker's Call is one of the best initiations in the game, and Counter Helix shreds illusion and summon heroes. Strong lane bully who falls off late; kited by ranged harass and undone by saves like False Promise.

champions.name: Bane
champions.notes: Fiend's Grip is a long single-target disable that pierces spell immunity, so it locks down a BKB carry; Nightmare adds pick and save utility. Grip is a channel, so it can be interrupted, and Counterspell or Rubick can reflect or steal it.

champions.name: Batrider
champions.notes: Blink + Firefly + Flaming Lasso drags one key target into the team; elite pick/initiation plus Sticky Napalm lane pressure. Needs follow-up; Rubick stealing Lasso and silences punish him.

champions.name: Beastmaster
champions.notes: Pro offlaner with early pressure from Razorback and rooting Raptors, plus Primal Roar, a spell-immunity-piercing single-target disable for picks. Wants to end early before fights turn into big AoE brawls.

champions.name: Bloodseeker
champions.notes: Snowbally skirmisher: Thirst hunts low-HP heroes and Rupture punishes blink and mobility heroes. Pairs well with forced movement (Lasso, Swap, Skewer). Falls off late and struggles vs Reincarnation, saves, and sustained right-click.

champions.name: Bounty Hunter
champions.notes: Roaming invisible pos4: Track grants True Sight and pays team gold, Big Game Hunter adds kill gold on the enemy's top-3 net-worth heroes, and marks targets for global/fast gankers. Premier counter to invis heroes; weak to reveals and tanky melee.

champions.name: Brewmaster
champions.notes: Primal Split initiator: Earth tank, Storm Cyclone/Dispel and Fire damage let him dictate fights; stances work while silenced. Very micro-intensive; Doom and silence before Split shut him down.

champions.name: Bristleback
champions.notes: Unkillable-from-behind frontliner who spams Quill Spray and Goo; great vs illusions and melee skirmishers. Break, %HP damage and heal reduction (Viper, Lifestealer, AA) are his hard counters.

champions.name: Broodmother
champions.notes: Spiderling lane-dominator and relentless tower/split pusher who wins early and must end games. Hard-countered by AoE that farms spiders (Leshrac, TA, Luna, Timbersaw, Dark Seer).

champions.name: Centaur Warrunner
champions.notes: Most-picked offlaner of TI 2026: tanky Blink + Hoof Stomp initiator with a global Stampede that works for engage or escape. Weak to pure/%HP damage and Break (Timbersaw, Lifestealer, Necrophos, Viper).

champions.name: Chaos Knight
champions.notes: Reality Rift + Chaos Bolt + crit illusions burst a single target in seconds. Strong mid-game diver; AoE illusion killers (Axe, Earthshaker, Leshrac) punish Phantasm.

champions.name: Chen
champions.notes: Creep-army micro support for early pushes, with global Hand of God heals and Zealot/Penitence utility. Must end early; creeps get deleted by AoE (Ion Shell, Leshrac) and the hero falls off late.

champions.name: Clinkz
champions.notes: Invisible armor-piercing carry (Infernal Shred, Searing Arrows, Skeleton Walk archers) who picks off isolated supports. Fragile; hard-countered by detection and reveals (Track, Corrosive Haze, Zeus).

champions.name: Clockwerk
champions.notes: Hookshot/Power Cogs pickoff initiator who isolates squishy backliners early; played as both pos4 and pos5. Needs follow-up damage; weak vs spell immunity/dispel carries (Lifestealer Rage, Jugg spin, Slark Dark Pact).

champions.name: Crystal Maiden
champions.notes: Lane-strong support with a root, AoE slows and team mana regen (Arcane Aura). Freezing Field is devastating behind big AoE lockdown. Very slow and fragile, so she is easily caught by gap-closers and invisible gankers.

champions.name: Dark Seer
champions.notes: Offlane enabler: Ion Shell wins lanes and deletes illusions/summons, Surge speeds cores, Vacuum + Wall of Replica set up AoE wombos. Needs AoE follow-up; spell-reliant, so silences and mana burn blunt him.

champions.name: Dark Willow
champions.notes: Control-heavy soft support: Bramble Maze roots, Cursed Crown stuns, Terrorize fears a whole team off a fight, and Bedlam bursts from Shadow Realm. Fragile; gap closers catch her.

champions.name: Dawnbreaker
champions.notes: Durable skirmisher whose global Solar Guardian lets her join any fight and heal allies; Starbreaker stuns and Luminosity sustains. Anti-heal and silences cut her impact.

champions.name: Dazzle
champions.notes: Save support: Shallow Grave negates burst/Duel/Rupture kills, Shadow Wave heals, Weave swings armor for physical lineups. Must stay alive and un-silenced; hard-countered by Ice Blast, Doom and Global Silence.

champions.name: Death Prophet
champions.notes: Premier tower-pusher: Exorcism spirits siege buildings, and Spirit Siphon plus Silence help her skirmish. Wants to force fights at towers early to mid game and falls off if the game drags.

champions.name: Disruptor
champions.notes: Glimpse and Kinetic Field trap mobile/blink heroes; Static Storm silences whole teams. Excellent vs escape-reliant cores; fragile vs divers and debuff-immune carries.

champions.name: Doom
champions.notes: Tanky offlaner (occasionally safelane) whose Doom dispels, silences and blocks healing on the enemy's key hero, with Scepter adding Break; farms fast via Devour. Premier answer to spell/save-reliant cores; single-target ult is weak vs illusion carries.

champions.name: Dragon Knight
champions.notes: Tanky pusher whose Elder Dragon Form now evolves by level (corrosive, then splash, then frost slow) to take towers and win extended fights while shrugging off physical damage. Good vs illusions and melee; weak to break (Viper), pure damage (Timbersaw) and kiting.

champions.name: Drow Ranger
champions.notes: Ranged mid-game carry with elite right-click DPS and Multishot, strong for fast tower-push lineups. Very immobile, so she needs peel and frontline and is punished hard by gap-closers and divers.

champions.name: Earth Spirit
champions.notes: One of the most contested heroes at TI 2026, now played mainly mid: stone remnants give roaming mobility, stuns, silences and repositioning (kicking enemies in or allies out). Silence and spell immunity blunt him.

champions.name: Earthshaker
champions.notes: Premier teamfight initiator: Fissure zoning plus a Blink Echo Slam that scales with the number of enemy units, making him the go-to answer to illusion and summon heroes. Needs Blink timing, and Rubick stealing Echo is a real threat.

champions.name: Elder Titan
champions.notes: Teamfight support: Echo Stomp sleeps groups, Natural Order removes armor and magic resistance, Earth Splitter deals %HP damage to lines of enemies. Best vs tanky lineups; pairs with nukers and physical cores.

champions.name: Ember Spirit
champions.notes: One of the most contested mids at TI 2026: Fire Remnants give elite mobility for split-pushing and skirmishing, Sleight of Fist wipes illusions. Silences, Duel and Doom pin him down.

champions.name: Enchantress
champions.notes: Long-range Impetus poke with heals and Untouchable, which cripples melee right-click carries. Needs a frontline to hide behind; vulnerable to magic burst and mobile divers.

champions.name: Enigma
champions.notes: Blink Black Hole is one of the strongest AoE lockdowns in the game and pierces spell immunity; a strong pro offlaner in 7.41. Needs AoE follow-up (Death Ward, Freezing Field, Requiem). Global Silence and Rubick punish it.

champions.name: Faceless Void
champions.notes: Late-game carry whose Chronosphere (default ult again since 7.41 removed facets) wins fights and pins mobile heroes. Pairs with ranged AoE damage that works inside Chrono. Rubick stealing Chrono is a disaster.

champions.name: Grimstroke
champions.notes: Lane bully with silence (Phantom's Embrace), AoE stun (Ink Swell) and Soulbind, which copies single-target spells onto a second enemy. Great with hex/stun teammates; spell immunity blunts him.

champions.name: Gyrocopter
champions.notes: Flak Cannon/Rocket Barrage multi-target damage that farms fast and wrecks illusions and summons. No escape; gets jumped by Duel, PA and mobile gankers. Io + Gyro is a classic combo.

champions.name: Hoodwink
champions.notes: One of the two most-picked heroes at TI 2026: Bushwhack stuns near trees, Acorn Shot and Sharpshooter give long-range poke, burst and Break, Scurry makes her slippery. Gap closers and tree-clearing heroes pressure her.

champions.name: Huskar
champions.notes: Low-HP berserker who dominates melee/strength lanes and dives with Life Break; needs save supports (Dazzle, Oracle). Heavily banned but poor when picked into prepared drafts; falls off late and is hard-countered by break, anti-heal, Necrophos and Culling Blade.

champions.name: Invoker
champions.notes: Level-scaling spellcaster with global Sun Strike, Tornado-Meteor-Blast teamfight burst and EMP vs mana heroes. Needs levels and space; mana burn, Doom and gap-closers punish him.

champions.name: Io
champions.notes: Tethers to a core for huge sustain and uses global Relocate for surprise ganks and saves. Needs a strong right-click core to empower; Ancient Apparition, Silencer and Doom neuter him.

champions.name: Jakiro
champions.notes: Lane-bully pushing support: Liquid Fire/Frost melt towers, Ice Path + Macropyre zone teamfights and clear illusions. Slow and immobile; punished by divers and invisible gankers.

champions.name: Juggernaut
champions.notes: Reliable carry with a strong lane (Blade Fury spell immunity), Healing Ward sustain and split-push. Omnislash deletes isolated squishies but is wasted on illusions, and he loses straight duels to Troll-style right-clickers.

champions.name: Keeper of the Light
champions.notes: Top-contested 7.41 hero (~100 TI 2026 bans), played as roaming pos4 in pro and as a mid: Illuminate gives elite waveclear and poke, Chakra Magic and Recall fuel pushes. Very squishy; gap closers and pick heroes (Storm, Batrider, Nyx, Clockwerk) punish him.

champions.name: Kez
champions.notes: Stance-swapping melee carry: Katana for sustained damage and Raven's Veil pick-offs, Sai for Talon Toss silence and BKB-piercing Raptor Dance. Most-picked carry at TI 2026 despite a low pub win rate; Keeper, Treant and ranged kiters handle him.

champions.name: Kunkka
champions.notes: Tanky teamfighter: Tidebringer cleave, Torrent and X Marks combos, and Ghost Ship for AoE stun and damage delay. Strong mid-game fights, but ranged mid lanes and magic-immune right-clickers give him trouble.

champions.name: Largo
champions.notes: Newest hero and a top ban at TI 2026, mostly played as an aura offlaner: rhythm-based Amphibian Rhapsody heals, speeds or spell-amps allies, Catchy Lick dispels/saves, Frogstomp zones. Disarmed while singing, so ranged harass and lane pressure punish him.

champions.name: Legion Commander
champions.notes: Blink + Duel picks off a core and snowballs damage stacks; a steady offlane pick. Save-heavy supports (Oracle, Dazzle, Omniknight, Abaddon) and Troll's Battle Trance ruin Duels.

champions.name: Leshrac
champions.notes: Diabolic Edict tower-destroyer and Pulse Nova AoE fighter; one of the best at fast pushes and clearing illusions/summons. Mana-hungry: countered by mana burn (Anti-Mage, Nyx) and silences.

champions.name: Lich
champions.notes: Lane-dominant support with Frost Shield and Sinister Gaze for peel, and Chain Frost for teamfight damage. Strong early and reliable throughout, but low mobility makes him a target for divers.

champions.name: Lifestealer
champions.notes: Rage-immune melee carry whose Feast shreds high-HP tanks; Infest lets him ride allies (Spirit Breaker, Batrider) into fights. Countered by anti-heal, debuff-immunity-piercing disables (Doom, Beastmaster) and pure damage.

champions.name: Lina
champions.notes: Heavily contested at TI 2026 (nerfed in 7.41f): elite magic burst (LSA, Laguna) plus Fiery Soul right-click lets her play mid, carry or support. Squishy and immobile, so she needs protection from divers and Anti-Mage's Counterspell.

champions.name: Lion
champions.notes: Two disables (Hex, Earth Spike) plus Finger of Death for easy pick-offs; Mana Drain instantly kills illusions. Very fragile and falls off late, so he relies on Blink positioning and on setting up his cores.

champions.name: Lone Druid
champions.notes: Innate Spirit Bear + Entangle root lane dominance that snowballs into tower pressure and split-pushing; top-tier pro pick/ban. Micro-heavy; Doom/Axe/Winter's Curse on the bear or druid ruin fights.

champions.name: Luna
champions.notes: Fast-farming Moon Glaives carry who clears waves and punishes illusion/summon heroes, spiking mid-game with Manta/BKB. Low armor and HP; needs frontline and gets jumped by Legion Commander, PA and Bristleback.

champions.name: Lycan
champions.notes: Offlane wolf-pack tower pusher and Shapeshift ganker who must convert early pressure into buildings. Falls off if stalled; AoE that kills wolves (Axe, Leshrac) blunts him.

champions.name: Magnus
champions.notes: Blink + Reverse Polarity is one of the best teamfight initiations; Skewer repositions enemies into his team and Empower fuels melee cores. Needs Blink timing; Rubick, silences and saves (Oracle, Wyvern) blunt it.

champions.name: Marci
champions.notes: Aggressive diver: Rebound engages or saves, Dispose throws enemies into her team and Unleash bursts squishies. Strongest early-mid; disarms and saves blunt her damage.

champions.name: Mars
champions.notes: Arena of Blood traps enemies for AoE follow-up and Spear of Mars pins targets; Bulwark tanks ranged physical damage. Strong laner and initiator that wants AoE partners.

champions.name: Medusa
champions.notes: Hyper-carry with elite late-game DPS: Mana Shield makes her tanky and Stone Gaze turns fights. Needs space to farm; mana burn (Anti-Mage, EMP, Diffusal) and early pressure beat her.

champions.name: Meepo
champions.notes: Multi-body ganker: Earthbind + Poof burst, farms and split-pushes everywhere, now copying items across clones. One clone dies, all die, so AoE (Earthshaker, Leshrac, TA, Ember) hard-counters him.

champions.name: Mirana
champions.notes: Most-picked support of the 7.41 pro meta (mostly pos4, also pos5): Sacred Arrow gives long-range picks and Moonlight Shadow sets up team-wide invisible engages or escapes. Nerfed in 7.41f; fragile, and Moonlight is countered by true sight (Haze, Track, Gem).

champions.name: Monkey King
champions.notes: Strong early laner and skirmisher: Jingu Mastery sustain, Boundless Strike stun-crit and Tree Dance mobility; Wukong's Command zones teamfights. Falls behind hard carries late.

champions.name: Morphling
champions.notes: High-skill scaling carry: Waveform and Attribute Shift make him slippery and hard to burst, and Morph lets him borrow an enemy hero's basic abilities. Io Tether is his classic enabler. Silences, Doom and mana burn shut him down.

champions.name: Muerta
champions.notes: Ranged carry whose Pierce the Veil turns her attacks into magic damage and grants physical immunity. Dead Shot fears, The Calling silences; weak early and vulnerable to magic burst and gap closers.

champions.name: Naga Siren
champions.notes: Illusion split-pusher who farms and takes buildings faster than almost anyone; Song of the Siren resets fights and sets up AoE combos. Hard countered by AoE (Earthshaker, Ember, Leshrac, Medusa) so draft around it.

champions.name: Nature's Prophet
champions.notes: Global split-pusher, now mostly a pos1: Teleportation + treants (which feed Spirit of the Forest damage) create map pressure and fast tower damage, Sprout sets up picks. Punished when caught alone by global/fast gankers (Spirit Breaker) and Timbersaw clearing trees.

champions.name: Necrophos
champions.notes: Sustain-heavy flex core (Death Pulse heals, Heartstopper aura, Ghost Shroud); Reaper's Scythe executes and delays buyback. Eats strength heroes and physical melee. Countered by anti-heal (Ice Blast), silences and mana burn.

champions.name: Night Stalker
champions.notes: Night-time ganker: Void and Crippling Fear silence catch mobile spellcasters, Dark Ascension gives flying vision, Midnight Feast sustains. Wants early fights and night timings; weak vs tanky/pure-damage offlaners and when games go late.

champions.name: Nyx Assassin
champions.notes: Invisible roaming ganker: Vendetta into Impale bursts squishy int cores, and Spiked Carapace punishes anyone who dives him. Needs early kills; true sight (Slardar, Bounty Hunter, Dust) shuts him down.

champions.name: Ogre Magi
champions.notes: Unkillable lane support with Multicast Fireblast stuns and Bloodlust for attack-speed cores. Strong early; low late impact and weak to pure damage and silence.

champions.name: Omniknight
champions.notes: Anti-physical protector: Guardian Angel is now a 700-radius aura around Omni with no linger, so he must stand in the fight; Repel grants debuff immunity and Purification/Hammer heal. Useless vs magic-heavy lineups and countered by silences and anti-heal.

champions.name: Oracle
champions.notes: Elite save support: False Promise, Fate's Edict and Fortune's End dispels undo burst and pick-offs. Weak laner who needs good timing; Ancient Apparition and Doom negate his saves.

champions.name: Outworld Devourer
champions.notes: Mana-scaling mid: Arcane Orb pure damage melts high-HP heroes, Objurgation barrier and Astral Imprisonment save himself or allies, Sanity's Eclipse punishes low-mana teams. Mana burn and silences counter him.

champions.name: Pangolier
champions.notes: Rolling Thunder initiator, now mostly a mid, with great mobility; Shield Crash and Swashbuckle make him a slippery skirmisher. Silences, walls (Disruptor) and Blade Fury shut down the roll.

champions.name: Phantom Assassin
champions.notes: Crit-burst assassin carry: Phantom Strike and Blur let her jump squishy targets. Evasion blanks many physical cores. Countered by armor, pure or magic damage (Helix, Timbersaw), ethereal and kiting.

champions.name: Phantom Lancer
champions.notes: Illusion army carry who spreads damage, burns mana with Diffusal and escapes with Doppelganger; strong vs single-target heroes. Hard-countered by AoE: Counter Helix, Echo Slam, cleave, Timbersaw and Bristleback quills.

champions.name: Phoenix
champions.notes: Teamfight hero: Icarus Dive engages, Sun Ray heals allies and burns enemies, Supernova is a fight-winning AoE stun if the egg survives. Anti-heal, spell immunity and fast attackers popping the egg counter it.

champions.name: Primal Beast
champions.notes: Tanky brawler: Onslaught charges in and stuns, Trample deals heavy AoE damage while moving, Pulverize locks one target through BKB. Kiting, Static Link and Doom hurt him.

champions.name: Puck
champions.notes: Elusive tempo mid with Dream Coil initiation, Waning Rift silence and top-tier mobility (Orb, Phase Shift). Punishes blink heroes, but silences and lockdown (Last Word, Crippling Fear, Doom) kill him.

champions.name: Pudge
champions.notes: Roaming pick-off hero: Meat Hook and Dismember isolate immobile targets, and he gets tankier with Flesh Heap and Meat Shield. Relies on hook accuracy and vision. Loses to %max-HP damage (Lifestealer, Ursa) and kiting.

champions.name: Pugna
champions.notes: Tower-razing nuker: Nether Blast takes buildings fast (Oblivion Savant adds spell amp per tower), Decrepify saves allies from physical burst or amplifies magic combos, Nether Ward punishes spell-spammers. Very fragile; dies to invisible/mana-burn gankers and silences.

champions.name: Queen of Pain
champions.notes: Tempo mid with short-cooldown Blink and AoE magic burst (Scream, Sonic Wave) who dives supports and rotates early. Falls off late. Silences and Rupture shut her down.

champions.name: Razor
champions.notes: Lane-dominant, easy-to-execute core: Static Link drains right-click carries' damage and Eye of the Storm pushes towers fast. Strong in the early and mid game but weak to kiting, magic burst and heal-denying sustain like Necrophos.

champions.name: Riki
champions.notes: Permanently invisible ganker: Blink Strike, Smoke Screen silence and Backstab burst delete isolated supports. Hard-countered by true sight (Haze, Zeus, Track, Gem) and AoE.

champions.name: Ring Master
champions.notes: Control support: Tame the Beasts fears, Wheel of Wonder mesmerizes a group, Impalement Arts bleeds and Escape Act boxes an ally to save them. Frequently picked; fragile and low-damage, so push lineups and mobile cores outpace him.

champions.name: Rubick
champions.notes: Flexible pos4: Telekinesis peel/setup and Spell Steal turns enemy teamfight ultimates (Black Hole, RP, Ravage, Echo Slam, Lasso) against them. Squishy; divers and invisible gankers punish him.

champions.name: Sand King
champions.notes: AoE initiator played mostly mid in pro: Burrowstrike stun plus a Blink Epicenter that wrecks illusions and clumped teams, with good waveclear and a Sand Storm escape. Epicenter now has only a cast point, not a channel; he falls off late.

champions.name: Shadow Demon
champions.notes: Disruption saves allies and sets up skillshots, Demonic Purge dispels enemy buffs and slows. Combos with point-target nukers (Split Earth, Sun Strike, Light Strike); fragile vs divers.

champions.name: Shadow Fiend
champions.notes: Farm-hungry core with fast Raze waveclear, an armor-reduction aura and Requiem teamfight burst. Played mostly as pos1 in pro. Nerfed in 7.41f; zero escape, so he is vulnerable to catch and lane bullies like Viper.

champions.name: Shadow Shaman
champions.notes: Best-in-class single-target lockdown (Hex into Shackles) and Mass Serpent Wards that take towers in seconds. Great for early push lineups. Shackles is a channel, and he is fragile to gap-closers.

champions.name: Silencer
champions.notes: Global Silence and Last Word shut down spell-reliant heroes and blink/BKB-less initiators; steals Int over the game. Little impact vs right-click lineups that ignore silence.

champions.name: Skywrath Mage
champions.notes: Glass-cannon magic burster: Ancient Seal + Mystic Flare deletes non-BKB targets and silences elusive mids. Extremely fragile; magic resistance, spell immunity and gap closers punish him.

champions.name: Slardar
champions.notes: Guardian Sprint + Slithereen Crush initiator whose Corrosive Haze gives huge armor reduction and true sight, making him a hard counter to invisible heroes. Falls off late and is kited by ranged lanes.

champions.name: Slark
champions.notes: Slippery skirmish carry who steals agility, purges disables with Dark Pact and escapes with Shadow Dance. Preys on immobile supports and backliners; undispellable lockdown (Rupture, Duel, Doom, Fiend's Grip) is the answer.

champions.name: Snapfire
champions.notes: Flexible zoner played mid, offlane and support: Mortimer Kisses and Scatterblast deal heavy AoE, Firesnap Cookie stuns or saves allies. Pairs with trapping setups like Arena; fragile vs invisible divers.

champions.name: Sniper
champions.notes: Extreme-range right-click poke and high-ground siege with Shrapnel and Assassinate. Needs a frontline and peel. Any gap-closer or invisible ganker kills him.

champions.name: Spectre
champions.notes: Global hyper-carry: Haunt joins every fight, Shadow Step is a long-range illusion gap-closer, Dispersion reflects burst and innate Desolate adds pure damage. Slow early; break (Viper, Doom scepter) and lane pressure are her kryptonite.

champions.name: Spirit Breaker
champions.notes: Global Charge of Darkness ganker who punishes split-pushers and immobile backliners; Greater Bash chain-stuns. Best early-mid; weak vs illusions, break and saves on the charge target.

champions.name: Storm Spirit
champions.notes: Mana-fuelled Ball Lightning diver who picks off backliners and scales into a slippery late-game threat. Hard-countered by mana burn (Anti-Mage), Rupture, silences, and Nyx.

champions.name: Sven
champions.notes: Cleave carry with an AoE Storm Hammer stun and huge God's Strength damage, great vs illusion and summon lineups. Combos with Empower, Tether and Swap. Kited or neutered by evasion, disarm/ethereal and Winter's Curse.

champions.name: Techies
champions.notes: Area-denial nuker: Sticky Bomb, Blast Off! and Proximity Mines give burst, zoning and strong high-ground defense. Fragile; gap closers and magic resistance punish him.

champions.name: Templar Assassin
champions.notes: Refraction-shielded burst carry, now mostly played pos1, who snowballs off early kills, towers and Roshan; Psi Blades shred illusions/summons. Collapses vs damage-over-time that strips Refraction (Bristleback, Venomancer, Timbersaw), armor reduction and True Sight.

champions.name: Terrorblade
champions.notes: Illusion hyper-carry with top-tier DPS and tower damage under Metamorphosis; Sunder turns low HP into a comeback. Low early impact; AoE (Axe, Earthshaker, Centaur, Dark Seer) and Borrowed Time are his weakness.

champions.name: Tidehunter
champions.notes: Durable frontliner whose Blink Ravage is one of the best AoE teamfight engages; Kraken Shell shrugs off harass. Pair with AoE follow-up. Rubick stealing Ravage and break or pure damage are his main problems.

champions.name: Timbersaw
champions.notes: Slippery pure-damage frontliner: Reactive Armor soaks right-clicks and Timber Chain makes him hard to pin down; Chakram gives sustained teamfight damage. Very mana-hungry; silences and mana burn shut him off.

champions.name: Tinker
champions.notes: Rearm-based burst and split-push mid who controls the map with March of the Machines, Deploy Turrets and Boots of Travel. Punished hard by gap-closers, global heroes and mana burn.

champions.name: Tiny
champions.notes: Avalanche + Toss burst-stun kills squishy heroes. Tiny is flexible between a tree-grab right-click carry (common pro pos1), a burst mid, and a roaming support. Classic Io tether-toss combo. Slow attack and struggles when kited.

champions.name: Treant Protector
champions.notes: Overgrowth AoE root stops blinks and escapes; Living Armor and Leech Seed sustain the team, Nature's Guise lets him roam invisibly. Top contested pos5 of 7.41d-e before the 7.41f nerfs; Timbersaw and debuff-immune carries blunt him.

champions.name: Troll Warlord
champions.notes: Straightforward right-click carry with huge attack speed (Fervor) and Battle Trance to win all-ins; knocks down towers fast. Kiting, Static Link, Winter's Curse and Helix-style punish counter him.

champions.name: Tusk
champions.notes: Roaming playmaker, one of the most-picked supports in 7.41 pro (pos5 or pos4): Snowball engages (and carries allies in), Ice Shards trap, Walrus Punch bursts. Falls off if early fights are lost.

champions.name: Underlord
champions.notes: Durable AoE offlaner: Firestorm and Pit of Malice control fights and clear illusions, Atrophy Aura weakens enemy damage and Fiend's Gate moves the whole team. Slow; kiting and spell immunity handle him.

champions.name: Undying
champions.notes: Decay Strength-steal lane bully, Tombstone zone control and Flesh Golem frontline for early fights; a heavily contested pos5 that also flexes to offlane. Tombstone combos with trapping ults (Arena, Kinetic Field); falls off late.

champions.name: Ursa
champions.notes: Early Roshan and single-target melee shredder (Fury Swipes, Enrage, HP-scaling Maul). Wants to end mid-game; countered by kiting, evasion, Untouchable/Guardian Angel and Winter's Curse.

champions.name: Vengeful Spirit
champions.notes: Aggressive lane support: Magic Missile stun, armor-reducing Wave of Terror and a damage aura for ranged pushes. Nether Swap pulls an enemy into the team or saves an ally. Also an occasional pro carry. Fragile; she needs vision to use Swap well.

champions.name: Venomancer
champions.notes: Lane-bullying poison support/offlaner with slows, Plague Wards for vision and push, and a Noxious Plague that punishes clumped teams. Falls off late and has no escape.

champions.name: Viper
champions.notes: Relentless lane bully; Viper Strike (2 charges) breaks passives (Bristleback, Spectre, PA, Huskar, Timbersaw) and Nethertoxin zones attack-speed carries. Strong early/mid, falls off late and its single-target damage struggles vs illusion carries (PL, Naga).

champions.name: Visage
champions.notes: Micro-heavy tempo hero, most often an offlaner in current pro play (also mid): familiars stun, gank and take towers early while Soul Assumption bursts. Wants to end mid-game; AoE that kills familiars stalls him.

champions.name: Void Spirit
champions.notes: Elusive magic-burst mid: Astral Step and Dissimilate give elite mobility, Aether Remnant pulls and Resonant Pulse shields. Picks off squishies; silences shut him down.

champions.name: Warlock
champions.notes: Teamfight support: Fatal Bonds, heals, Upheaval and a Chaotic Offering AoE stun that drops a Golem for frontline. Strong in clumped fights, but slow and fragile vs divers.

champions.name: Weaver
champions.notes: Elusive Shukuchi/Time Lapse skirmisher; Swarm armor reduction, Threads of Fate and Geminate Attack burst immobile targets. Hard to pin down but flimsy; countered by True Sight/reveals (Track, Corrosive Haze).

champions.name: Windranger
champions.notes: Flexible core/support: Shackleshot is a long stun that pairs with trees or units, Windrun evasion blanks right-click carries, and Focus Fire gives her carry damage. Vulnerable to magic burst and silences.

champions.name: Winter Wyvern
champions.notes: Staple 7.41 hard support: Winter's Curse turns a diving core against its own team and Cold Embrace saves from physical damage. Best vs right-click carries; weaker vs magic burst and silences.

champions.name: Witch Doctor
champions.notes: Teamfight support: bouncing Paralyzing Cask, heals, Maledict, and a Death Ward that shreds anything held in place by Chrono, Black Hole or Call. The Ward is a channel, so stuns, silences and divers answer it.

champions.name: Wraith King
champions.notes: Simple, tanky right-click carry with lifesteal, a stun, Bone Guard skeletons and Reincarnation (no mana cost at max level). Strong in pubs, rarely picked in pro. Anti-heal, kiting and early mana burn (Reincarnation still costs mana at levels 1-2) are his weaknesses.

champions.name: Zeus
champions.notes: Spammable magic nukes plus global Thundergod's Wrath. His true sight reveals invisible heroes, and Static Field chunks high-HP targets. Zero escape beyond Heavenly Jump, so he is a prime target for divers and magic-resistant cores.
